text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, it came out so adorable. As expected 
of the "Chan-chan Alliance's" #1 
cute-photo artisan...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ehe♪ I'm honored! Since it's a 
commemorative birthday shoot for you, 
Ma-chan, Curren put extra effort into it 
too!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Hey, let's post this on Umastagram right 
away so everyone can celebrate Ma-chan 
too♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Curren will post too: "#StarOfTheDay #Is 
#Machan #happybirthday #Celebrating 
#Together #ChanChanAlliance"... and done.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, once we finish uploading this, 
let's go buy the cake we're gonna eat for 
tonight's birthday livestream!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"Invoking my Birthday Star privileges. I 
request a cake that's tumbling in a sea of 
whipped cream and fruit."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Request from the star of the day: 
Accepted♪
